input: Take a guided architecture walking tour downtown

gold.taskTitle: Take a guided architecture walking tour downtown
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to go on a guided architecture walking tour in a downtown area.

questions.title: Which city's downtown are you touring?
questions.description: Identify the specific city or downtown area where the tour will take place.

questions.title: Have you already booked a tour or not yet?
questions.description: Determine whether the user needs to find and book a tour or already has one scheduled.

questions.title: Do you prefer a private guide or group tour?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants a private guided experience or is comfortable joining a public group.

questions.title: What is your target date for this tour?
questions.description: Establish a specific date or timeframe the user is planning to take the tour.

questions.title: How long are you willing to walk?
questions.description: Understand the user's preferred tour duration or distance tolerance.

questions.title: Is there a specific architectural style that interests you?
questions.description: Find out if the user has a preference for a particular era or style, such as Art Deco, Modernist, or Beaux-Arts.

questions.title: What is your budget for this tour?
questions.description: Determine how much the user is willing to spend so appropriate tour options can be identified.
